title: 5.16.2 Check: the Snake game
description: Six multiple-choice questions on the grid, the beat, steering without turning back, moving and growing with unshift and pop, and searching the snake. Checked instantly.

questions.question: A cell is 20 pixels wide. Which pixel x puts the centre of a sprite in the middle of column 3?
questions.explanation: Column 3 starts at 3 * 20 = 60, and the centre is half a cell further, so 70. A sprite's x is its centre.

questions.question: What does changing `frameCount % 8` to `frameCount % 4` do to the snake?
options: It moves twice as often, so it is faster
It moves half as often, so it is slower
It moves two cells per step
Nothing
questions.explanation: The step runs on every 4th frame instead of every 8th, so there are twice as many steps a second.

questions.question: Why do the up and down keys only work when `dy === 0`?
options: To stop the snake from turning back into itself
To make the snake faster
Because up and down are the same key
To keep the score from rising
questions.explanation: If the snake is moving down, `dy` is 1, so up is refused. Without the test, one key press sends the snake straight into its own neck.

questions.question: How does the whole snake move one step?
options: Every cell is moved one place forward
A new head is added at the front and the tail is removed
The head is deleted and rebuilt
The canvas scrolls backwards
questions.explanation: The middle cells never move. A cell appears in front and one disappears at the back, which looks like sliding.

questions.question: What makes the snake one cell longer when it eats?
options: An extra `push` at the back
The tail is not removed on that step
The head is made twice as big
The beat gets shorter
questions.explanation: A head was added and nothing was taken from the tail, so the array has one more item.

questions.question: In `isBody`, why does `return false` sit after the loop and not inside it?
options: Inside the loop it would end the function after checking only the first segment
Because `return false` is not allowed in a loop
So the loop runs once
It makes no difference
questions.explanation: A return inside the loop would answer after the first segment. After the loop, it only runs when no segment matched.
